observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment session event and checkout revalidation state

outcome.revalidation_result: Selected checkout refreshed from stale campaign branch and HEAD to the observed main checkout and HEAD.
outcome.subsequent_claim_result: The exact worktree claim succeeded after manual session revalidation.
outcome.relationship_to_implementation: This is the authentic pre-change recovery sequence that motivated the regression. It is not evidence of a post-change production claim outcome.

measurement_limits: The event records the claim failure category and code; source inspection and the checkout snapshot supplied the selected-anchor cause.
The recovery sequence occurred before the implementation commit and does not demonstrate that a later live operation is faster or succeeds without intervention.
No total elapsed recovery time, tool-call count, or cross-session recurrence was measured.
